pecas.prompt:
A sheet showing 6 separate animals arranged in a tidy 2x3 grid. Each animal sits alone inside its own cell, well separated from the others, none of them touching, all drawn at the same scale and lit the same way, each one whole and complete inside its cell with clear empty margin around it. Soft matte clay 3D illustration, children's storybook style, rich saturated colours, soft shadows. Soft even studio light coming from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly under the object. The background behind every animal is one single plain perfectly flat bright magenta colour (#FF00FF) that fills every part of the sheet the animals do not cover, right up to their edges, with the same magenta showing through any gap between a leg, a tail, a wing or a beak. Every surface is smooth, blank and unmarked. The image contains only the object itself. Modelled in soft matte clay, like a children's storybook toy. The animals, in reading order from left to right and top to bottom, are:
  1. a plump friendly honey bee with round yellow and black striped body, tiny translucent wings and a smiling face, seen from the side
  2. a cute sitting house cat with soft grey striped fur, upright ears, a long tail curled around its paws and big friendly eyes, seen from the side
  3. a friendly green alligator standing on all four short legs, long snout closed in a smile, bumpy back and long tail, seen from the side
  4. a cheerful little brown monkey sitting upright, pale round face, long tail curling up behind it, seen from the side
  5. a smiling green frog sitting upright on its back legs, smooth round body, big cheerful eyes on top of its head, seen from the front
  6. a toucan bird perched sideways, glossy black body, white throat and a very large bright orange beak, seen from the side
